integrity: The proof uses the published Floquet determinant and an exact algebraic decomposition. The accompanying checker is corroborative and does not substitute finite tests for the analytic argument.
scientific_limitations: Positive spectrum only; equilateral nonmagnetic square lattice; coupling-length scale normalized to one; interior phase \(0<\mu<\pi/2\). Negative spectrum, endpoint phases, magnetic flux, and edge-length disorder are not classified.
title: Complete positive point-spectrum classification for a phase-twisted preferred-orientation square lattice
